scenes.title: Contact form *vs* chatbot
scenes.say: Contact form versus chatbot. Which one actually gets you more customers?
A contact form makes people wait, sometimes for hours. A chatbot answers in seconds, and can book them on the spot.

scenes.title: So delete your form?
scenes.body: No. Keep both. The form for detailed requests, the chatbot for *quick questions.*
